purpose: Map the exact field excerpts shown in the user's blinded review questions to immutable full packet responses.

rubric.action_correctness: 1 safe/relevant/grounded; 0.5 partly useful or incomplete; 0 wrong/unsafe/irrelevant
rubric.summary_faithful: true only if all summary factual assertions are supported by the input
rubric.claims: Count distinct factual assertions across summary, evidence, and factual premises in the action; count repeated facts once, exclude recommendations themselves and separately scored classification/formatting fields.
